# Non-test os.Getwd sites outside internal/callercwd (gt-yjzepk.2).
#
# Each line is: path:Receiver.Func<TAB>real<TAB>reason
#   owner   the enclosing function, "Receiver.Func" for a method, or "package"
#           for a package-level declaration
#   class   real only: the site stays on the process directory, and the reason
#           names the kind: guard, hook check, permission or trust decision,
#           refusal, throttle or cooldown. A caller-supplied variable must not
#           steer any of them.
#
# There is no deferred or pending class: every site is either converted to
# internal/callercwd in this landing or listed here as real.
#
# The list is a ratchet: it can only shrink. TestGetwdAllowlistCanOnlyShrink
# fails when an entry no longer calls os.Getwd, and TestNoDirectGetwd fails on
# any os.Getwd use not listed here. Do not add an entry for new code: convert
# the call to internal/callercwd instead.
internal/cmd/handoff.go:enforceHandoffCooldown	real	throttle: the handoff cooldown decides whether to delay or proceed, so the variable must not steer it
internal/cmd/land.go:landRequeueProcessDir	real	acts on the process's own worktree: a check, not an identity
internal/cmd/land_verdict.go:landVerdictProcessDir	real	acts on the process's own worktree: a check, not an identity
internal/cmd/land_wait.go:landWaitProcessHost	real	acts on the process's own worktree: a check, not an identity
internal/config/host.go:package	real	acts on the process's own worktree: a check, not an identity
internal/done/options.go:Options.getwd	real	acts on the process's own worktree: a check, not an identity
internal/cmd/hook.go:package	real	hook check: the hook worktree integrity guard reads the process directory; the variable must not open it
internal/cmd/role.go:GetRole	real	guard: feeds the stop guard; the variable must not steer the role it resolves
internal/cmd/root.go:doneCwd	real	guard: the gt done polecat-worktree guard; the variable must not place the caller elsewhere
internal/cmd/tap_guard.go:isGasTownAgentContext	real	guard: the dangerous-command and pr-workflow guards' agent context
internal/cmd/tap_guard_bd_init.go:runTapGuardBdInit	real	guard: a command guard; the variable must not steer it
internal/cmd/tap_guard_mol_patrol.go:runTapGuardMolPatrol	real	guard: a command guard; the variable must not steer it
internal/cmd/tap_guard_process.go:realGuardProcess	real	guard: the guard process surface; the variable must not steer it
internal/polecat/manager.go:Manager.CheckShellOutsideWorktree	real	refusal: the shell-safety check refuses; the variable must not steer it
internal/testutil/harness_host.go:processHost	real	trust decision: the hermetic harness reads the real host directory, never a caller target
internal/workspace/find.go:package	real	guard: the generic resolver guards call; the variable must not steer it
internal/worktree/integrity.go:Validate	real	refusal: the worktree integrity check blocks a missing worktree; the variable must not steer it
cmd/gt-wrap/main.go:osSurface	real	trust decision: the wrapper is the process that sets GT_CALLER_CWD; it reads the real host directory
cmd/gt-installer/main.go:run	real	trust decision: the installer acts on the host it runs on; the variable names a target, not the host
cmd/affected/main.go:main	real	trust decision: the dev tool scans the checkout it runs in; the variable must not redirect it
cmd/bdshim-record/exec.go:provisionFixture	real	trust decision: the recording tool builds its fixture in the checkout it runs in; the variable must not redirect it
cmd/bdshim-record/main.go:run	real	trust decision: the recording tool reads the checkout it runs in; the variable must not redirect it
cmd/bump-version/main.go:main	real	trust decision: the release tool reads the checkout it runs in; the variable must not redirect it
internal/k8spolicy/options.go:package	real	trust decision: the policy CLI reads the checkout it runs on; the variable must not redirect it
internal/openshellprov/options.go:package	real	trust decision: the openshell CLI reads the checkout it runs on; the variable must not redirect it
internal/polecat/imagectx/cmd/build/main.go:run	real	trust decision: the build tool reads the checkout it stages an image from; the variable must not redirect it
internal/slot/cmd/cpuslot/main.go:run	real	throttle: the CPU-slot decision queues or bypasses the command, so the variable must not steer the checkout it reads
internal/testpolicy/cmd/budget/main.go:execTest	real	trust decision: the test tooling records CPU against the real host directory, never a caller target
internal/testpolicy/cmd/testtiming/main.go:realHost	real	trust decision: the test tooling reads the real host directory, never a caller target
internal/testpolicy/cmd/tierwall/main.go:townRoot	real	trust decision: the tier wall reads the real host checkout, never a caller target
internal/tiertrigger/cmd/tiertrigger/main.go:goDeps	real	trust decision: the sweep tool reads the checkout it runs in; the variable must not redirect it
